assertions: Relevant-memory retrieval applies the active and unexpired eligibility rule both in the database query and in the returned collection.
Disabled memory contents are collected only for suppression and are redacted from session digests and model-visible history.
The Agent system prompt contains one local-date anchor used for today, yesterday, and tomorrow references.
The suppression and date-anchor helpers have deterministic contract coverage.
red_test: A disabled memory and an expired memory must not enter the eligible context, and disabled text must not survive in history or digest text.
green_test: npm run test:agent -> 9 passed, 0 failed; npm run test:memory -> 4 passed, 0 failed; npx tsx --test scripts/consolidation-contract.test.ts -> 4 passed, 0 failed; npm run test:ordering -> 12 passed, 0 failed; npm run lint, npm run typecheck, and git diff --check passed.
same_case_requirement: Issue #5 disabled-memory suppression and Issue #8 relative-date interpretation now use an explicit, testable boundary while Issues #3-#8 remain open.
